name: Water Elementaling
description: An elementaling is a manifestation of an element that is lacking sentience, often the result of primordial magic. They commonly present in their raw elemental form but shape themselves to emulate certain creatures such as humanoids or beasts.

actions.name: Water Whip
actions.description: The Water Elementaling slashes with a whip of water at a creature, dealing physical and cold damage.

actions.name: Surge
actions.description: The Water Elementaling surges forward, moving up to 4 units, passing through creatures and dousing any magical or non-magical flame. This movement does not provoke reactions.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving the water elementaling's area of control, it makes an attack against them with it's Water Whip action.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.description: Elementals have special protection against physical damage from weapons and ammunition that do not have the magical property, halving any damage before mitigations are applied.

traits.name: Essence of Water
traits.description: The Water Elementaling gains a 1d4 bonus to attack checks while submerged in water.
